seoTitle: Email Deliverability Checklist: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, List Hygiene
metaDescription: A tick-off checklist for email authentication, list hygiene, sending practice and content. Progress is saved in your browser only. Free.
intro: Work through authentication, list hygiene, sending practice and content items, with progress saved in this browser.
why:
Inbox placement depends on many small things done right: authentication records, a clean consented list, steady volume and honest content. A checklist makes gaps visible before a campaign instead of after.

It is a starting list, not a guarantee. Mailbox providers change requirements, so check current Google and Yahoo sender rules. The complaint-rate item reflects Google's guideline of staying below 0.1% and never reaching 0.3%. Progress is stored in your browser and not sent anywhere.
howTo: Tick the items you have done.
Follow up on the unticked ones, starting with authentication.
Use the record analysers to check SPF, DKIM and DMARC.

faq.a: Yes, in this browser only, using local storage.

faq.q: Is this enough for inbox placement?
faq.a: No. It lowers risk but cannot guarantee delivery.

faq.q: Where is the one-click unsubscribe rule from?
faq.a: Google and Yahoo ask bulk senders for it. Check their current pages.
